title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Codex Milestone Tease: OpenAI engineer Tibo (@thsottiaux) teases an upcoming Codex dashboard milestone, prompting developer commentary on transitioning from Cursor to Codex.
MiniMax H3 Max Infinite Stream: Rehan Sheikh (@rehan_shei) connects MiniMax H3 Max video generation to a Twitch stream for real-time interdimensional video synthesis.
Mourinho & Kane Football Milestones: José Mourinho's comments on Ballon d'Or criteria go viral while Harry Kane becomes the first English player named Germany's Footballer of the Year.
CZ & Crypto Leadership Harmony: Binance founder CZ (@cz_binance) shares thoughts on professional ethics and mutual respect in crypto industry disputes.
Gen Z Financial Behavior Shift: Anthony Pompliano (@APompliano) highlights data showing Gen Z investors demonstrate greater risk awareness due to expanded financial education.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Codex Milestone Teased as Developers Shift Tools
items.body: OpenAI Codex engineer Tibo teases a major dashboard milestone celebration while developers like Jim Liu share transitions from Cursor to Codex for codebase refactoring.

items.title: @rehan_shei: Real-Time Interdimensional Video Generation via MiniMax H3 Max

items.title: @davitb: Krisp Releases VIVA 2.5 Voice Isolation Architecture

items.title: @Box: Box Launches Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

items.title: @cz_binance: CZ Advocates for Industry Restraint & Ethics in Crypto Disputes
items.body: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) emphasizes that corporate competition and public disputes in crypto should not compromise personal careers or ethics.

items.title: @APompliano: Gen Z Financial Literacy & Risk Aversion Growth

items.title: @NikiDegtyarev: Startup Scaling Momentum Following YC Rejection
items.body: A founder shares post-application metrics showing 3.5x revenue growth and 3x paying user expansion within two months of continuing independent execution.
